Slides for the *International Finance* course. Each session is a set of
reveal.js slides you can open in a browser, plus a PDF handout of the same
material.

**In the slides:** `→` `←` move, `O` gives the overview, `F` is fullscreen,
`E` then print makes a PDF of the slides as they look on screen.

## Readings

- Session 1–2 — Monasterolo, I. (2020), *Climate Change and the Financial System*, **Annual Review of Resource Economics** 12
- Session 3–4 — Sartzetakis, E.S. (2021), *Green bonds as an instrument to finance low carbon transition*, **Economic Change and Restructuring** 54
- Session 5–6 — Muñoz, F. (2020), *How do the size and independence of the board of trustees affect the financial and sustainable performance of socially responsible mutual funds?*, **Corporate Social Responsibility and Environmental Management** 27(4)

Read the paper **before** the session it belongs to. Course description and
announcements are on [LEARN](http://learn.kedgebs.com).

## Assessment

| | Weight | When |
|:---|:--:|:---|
| Individual assignment | 20% | Session 7 |
| Group work — security analysis | 40% | Session 8 |
| Final exam | 40% | Session 10 |

A calculator is required for most sessions.
